notes.title: Small Fix
notes.content: Fixed an issue with being blocked in a town, and made some spelling corrections.

notes.title: Fixes
notes.content: Fixed prices for ultimate skill shop.

notes.title: Version 1.35
notes.content:
Fixed some more transfer issues. 
With over 10,000 transfer points, I guess there were bound to be a few that didn't do quite what we wanted.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content: Fixed issue with Main Quest 26 not allowing progression.

notes.title: Version 1.3
notes.content:
Added a new shop in Greymoore Guild for Ultimate Skills
Fixed transfer issue in Lagon
SteamDeck Compatability now finished and published on Steam Page.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that wouldn't let Enchanter Skill M.Barrier All activate.
Fixed a few collision and transfer bugs.

notes.title: Version 1.21
notes.content:
Fixed a Starting location bug from last update.
Fixed several text errors.
Fervian's head still falls off, but the bug is timed so perfectly with the text that I'm keeping it ːsteammockingː.

notes.title: Version 1.20
notes.content: Fixed an issue with the game crashing as the player entered any dungeon with a recruitable monster.

notes.title: Version 1.19
notes.content: Fixed an issue that wouldn't allow the Carrington Bandit Quest to be completed.

notes.title: Version 1.18
notes.content:
Added the Bestiary to the Guild Halls. You can find it on the bookshelf in each hall except
Phanad and Greymoore. The Bestiary will be sitting on the lower table.

Achievement integration setup.
